cards.back:
A special time when people celebrate together.
Bahasa Indonesia: festival
Example: The village festival has music, dancing and a colourful parade.
cards.say: festival. A special time when people celebrate together. The village festival has music, dancing and a colourful parade.

cards.back:
A happy event to mark a special day.
Bahasa Indonesia: perayaan
Example: Our family held a big celebration for my grandmother's birthday.
cards.say: celebration. A happy event to mark a special day. Our family held a big celebration for my grandmother's birthday.

cards.back:
A line of people moving through the streets to celebrate.
Bahasa Indonesia: pawai
Example: Drummers and dancers marched in the parade through town.
cards.say: parade. A line of people moving through the streets to celebrate. Drummers and dancers marched in the parade through town.

cards.back:
Special clothes worn for a show, party or festival.
Bahasa Indonesia: kostum
Example: She wore a bright costume with a feathered headdress.
cards.say: costume. Special clothes worn for a show, party or festival. She wore a bright costume with a feathered headdress.

cards.back:
A custom that people have followed for a long time.
Bahasa Indonesia: tradisi
Example: It is a family tradition to share ketupat at Eid.
cards.say: tradition. A custom that people have followed for a long time. It is a family tradition to share ketupat at Eid.

cards.back:
A way of behaving that is usual in a group or place.
Bahasa Indonesia: adat
Example: Taking off your shoes at the door is a local custom.
cards.say: custom. A way of behaving that is usual in a group or place. Taking off your shoes at the door is a local custom.

cards.back:
A formal event held on an important occasion.
Bahasa Indonesia: upacara
Example: The school held a ceremony to welcome the new pupils.
cards.say: ceremony. A formal event held on an important occasion. The school held a ceremony to welcome the new pupils.

cards.back:
A light with a cover so the flame or bulb is protected.
Bahasa Indonesia: lampion
Example: Children carried paper lanterns through the dark street.
cards.say: lantern. A light with a cover so the flame or bulb is protected. Children carried paper lanterns through the dark street.

cards.back:
Objects that explode with bright lights and loud bangs in the sky.
Bahasa Indonesia: kembang api
Example: We watched the fireworks burst in the sky at midnight.
cards.say: fireworks. Objects that explode with bright lights and loud bangs in the sky. We watched the fireworks burst in the sky at midnight.

cards.back:
A large, special meal for many people.
Bahasa Indonesia: jamuan
Example: The family prepared a feast of rice, curry and fresh fruit.
cards.say: feast. A large, special meal for many people. The family prepared a feast of rice, curry and fresh fruit.

cards.back:
To make something look nicer by adding things to it.
Bahasa Indonesia: menghias
Example: We decorate the hall with flowers before the wedding.
cards.say: decorate. To make something look nicer by adding things to it. We decorate the hall with flowers before the wedding.

cards.back:
Traditions and buildings passed down from the past.
Bahasa Indonesia: warisan budaya
Example: Borobudur is part of Indonesia's rich cultural heritage.
cards.say: heritage. Traditions and buildings passed down from the past. Borobudur is part of Indonesia's rich cultural heritage.

cards.back:
A family member who lived long ago.
Bahasa Indonesia: leluhur
Example: We tidy the grave to honour our ancestors.
cards.say: ancestor. A family member who lived long ago. We tidy the grave to honour our ancestors.

cards.back:
A set of actions done in a fixed way, often for religion.
Bahasa Indonesia: ritual
Example: The priest carried out a quiet ritual at dawn.
cards.say: ritual. A set of actions done in a fixed way, often for religion. The priest carried out a quiet ritual at dawn.

cards.back:
A line of people walking slowly together as part of an event.
Bahasa Indonesia: arak-arakan
Example: A long procession of dancers carried offerings to the temple.
cards.say: procession. A line of people walking slowly together as part of an event. A long procession of dancers carried offerings to the temple.

cards.back:
A gift given to a god or spirit.
Bahasa Indonesia: persembahan
Example: She placed an offering of flowers by the gate.
cards.say: offering. A gift given to a god or spirit. She placed an offering of flowers by the gate.

cards.back:
A public festival with music, parades and street fun.
Bahasa Indonesia: karnaval
Example: We danced in the street at the summer carnival.
cards.say: carnival. A public festival with music, parades and street fun. We danced in the street at the summer carnival.

cards.back:
Words you say or write when you meet someone.
Bahasa Indonesia: ucapan salam
Example: A warm greeting was printed on every card.
cards.say: greeting. Words you say or write when you meet someone. A warm greeting was printed on every card.

cards.back:
A meeting of people who have not seen each other for a while.
Bahasa Indonesia: reuni
Example: We have a family reunion in my grandparents' village every year.
cards.say: reunion. A meeting of people who have not seen each other for a while. We have a family reunion in my grandparents' village every year.

cards.back:
A meeting of people in one place.
Bahasa Indonesia: pertemuan, perkumpulan
Example: The whole street joined the gathering in the park.
cards.say: gathering. A meeting of people in one place. The whole street joined the gathering in the park.

cards.back:
Holy and treated with great respect.
Bahasa Indonesia: suci, keramat
Example: The villagers treat the old tree as a sacred place.
cards.say: sacred. Holy and treated with great respect. The villagers treat the old tree as a sacred place.

cards.back:
All the people born at around the same time.
Bahasa Indonesia: generasi
Example: Each generation teaches the next how to cook the special dish.
cards.say: generation. All the people born at around the same time. Each generation teaches the next how to cook the special dish.
